messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: elevated 5xx rate on eu-central-api-prod. Source: provider A upstream latency spike. Auto-escalation to on-call (sam) triggered.

sam (oncall): seeing p95 token latency jump from ~120ms -> 1.2s on /v1/generate in eu-central. 5xx rate ~4.8% last 10m. Can someone grab provider health and route metrics? @marco @priya

priya (sre): I have the provider dashboard open. Provider A egress latency spike starting 2024-11-03T10:02Z, origin datacenter eu-central-1. Error traces show TCP retransmits and HTTP/2 GOAWAYs. Looks like upstream capacity issues.

marco (infra): Confirmed. BGP telemetry shows increased AS path flaps to Provider A in that region. Also seeing GPU pod queue length increase on dedicated nodes behind that provider.

emily (platform): Quick note — two high-usage customers (AcmeCorp, BetaHealth) are heavy RT-embed traffic. Embedding routes are the biggest token drain right now. If we need to preserve capacity, we should consider toggling realtime-embeds or applying soft rate limits to those routes.

sam (oncall): Priority: avoid broad customer impact. Plan proposal: 1) rate-limit embedding endpoints for non-SLA tenants (soft) 2) start provider-reroute from Provider A -> Provider B for eu-central, staged 10% -> 50% -> 100% 3) disable non-critical realtime feature flag (rt-embeds) for free-tier while we stabilize. Any objections?

jordan (support): Heads-up: AcmeCorp support ticket already inbound reporting increased latency on embeddings. I'll update them if we apply mitigation.

priya (sre): I'll run staged reroute. Marco, can you prepare BGP/routing playbook? I'll coordinate rate-limits and the feature toggle.

marco (infra): Preparing. Running dry-run to ensure provider B has capacity. If we failover too fast we'll create thrash. I'll coordinate step cadence in channel.

ops-bot: @sam initiated incident-1942003456; severity: S3; responders: sam, priya, marco, emily, jordan. Paging log: https://opslogs/redwood/incidents/1942003456

priya (sre): Executing step 1: applying soft token rate-limit to /v1/embeddings for free-tier and unverified customers. Command: ```
# apply rate limit via gateway
POST /admin/rate_limit
{
  "route": "/v1/embeddings",
  "policy": "soft",
  "limit": "50req/min",
  "targets": ["free","unverified"]
}
```

sam (oncall): Noted. Priya, please add a quick metric alert for customer 5xx increase after rate-limit so we can roll back if something breaks.

priya (sre): Added alert. Also enabling quota bump for priority customers so their jobs don't get hit: ```
# temporary quota override
PATCH /admin/quotas
{
  "customers": ["AcmeCorp","BetaHealth"],
  "quota": {"embeddings_per_min": 1000}
}
```

marco (infra): Starting staged provider reroute. Step A: 10% traffic to Provider B for eu-central. Command I ran: ```
# routectl
routectl set-weight --region eu-central --from provider-A --to provider-B --weight 10
```

incident-bot: provider-reroute event recorded: eu-central 10% -> Provider B by marco at 2024-11-03T10:10Z

sam (oncall): Observing metrics after 10% shift — latency drop ~8% overall, provider A 5xx rate slightly reduced. No regressions yet. Proceed to 50%?

marco (infra): Proceeding to 50% in 2m. Also adjusting connection pool sizes on our egress for Provider B to handle higher concurrency.

emily (platform): Rolling out feature toggle: disabling rt-embeds for free-tier only. This will reduce load but keep paid workflows intact. Toggle command: `flagsctl set rt-embeds free-tier false --reason "incident preservation"`

priya (sre): Toggle applied. Monitor: embedding token throughput down ~38% in eu region. AcmeCorp unaffected (SLA).

jordan (support): Updated AcmeCorp — they acknowledged quota bump and noticed improvement. BetaHealth on a support call, they saw transient errors earlier but are back to normal.

sam (oncall): Good. Marco, continue to 100% if Provider B looks stable. We'll keep soft limits in place for 30m, then slowly remove.

marco (infra): Moving to 100% now. routectl set-weight ... --weight 100

incident-bot: provider-reroute event recorded: eu-central 100% -> Provider B by marco at 2024-11-03T10:28Z

priya (sre): After full cutover, p95 on generate back to ~140ms, 5xx < 0.5%. No sign of provider B issues. Embedding throughput stable.

sam (oncall): Initiating customer impact assessment for post-incident notes: affected customers list, actions taken (rate-limits, quota overrides, feature toggle, provider reroute), start/end times, handoffs. Priya will author initial incident timeline.

emily (platform): Note for postmortem: evaluate why Provider A BGP/egress degraded; add a playbook for safer reroutes (circuit breaker on RTT + connection errors vs raw 5xx). Also consider per-customer dynamic fallback instead of global toggle.

marco (infra): Filing infra action item: add healthcheck gating to provider failover so we can probe provider B before full weight swap.

priya (sre): Handoff: I'm going to own stabilization and timeline. @sam you can go offline in 30m if no new alerts. I'll keep monitoring and consolidate logs.

sam (oncall): Thanks team. Leaving on-call to priya in 30m. Please keep this thread updated. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: oncall-handoff recorded: sam -> priya at 2024-11-03T10:45Z

priya (sre): 11:40Z status update: all metrics stable, re-enabled rt-embeds for free-tier in dry mode (10% sample) to verify behavior. No regression. Preparing initial incident Slack summary for stakeholders and a postmortem ticket.

jordan (support): I'll send a customer summary to AcmeCorp & BetaHealth outlining actions and ETA for follow-up postmortem.

incident-bot: incident-1942003456 mitigated at 2024-11-03T11:55Z. Next steps: postmortem ticket #INC-1942003456, owners: priya (lead), marco (infra), emily (platform).

priya (sre): Closing notes: root cause appears to be transient Provider A egress instability leading to TCP retransmits and a cascade into our request queues. Mitigations: staged reroute, soft rate-limits, tiered quota overrides, feature toggle. Action items assigned in ticket.

sam (oncall): Thanks everyone. Great coordination.

emily (platform): Adding follow-ups: (1) add automatic provider health gating for reroutes, (2) per-customer dynamic fallbacks, (3) evaluate embed batching improvements to reduce peak pressure.

marco (infra): Will add BGP telemetry alerts to detect AS path instability earlier.

jordan (support): I'll mark customer notifications as sent.

priya (sre): Incident thread closed. Will file the full postmortem in the incidents board by EOD.

sam (oncall): Marking this resolved on my side. :white_check_mark:
